description: Read the user's pass / fixable / fail verdicts and reasons for a review created with request_human_review, without waiting. Returns progress, every verdict so far, the cases where the user disagreed with your judge, the agreement rate, and a next step. Treat the user's verdicts as ground truth for the eval set; disagreements show where the rubric or judge prompt needs a new rule.
name: get_human_judgments
title: Read the user's verdicts
